name: Rocket Force Command College
zh: 中国人民解放军火箭军指挥学院

evidence.summary: CASI describes the Rocket Force Command College in Wuhan, founded in 1977 as the Second Artillery School and given its present name in 2015, as the PLA Rocket Force’s professional education college for commanders, awarding master’s and doctoral degrees in military science. Its facilities include combat-training simulation and missile test buildings, and its departments have included command, communications, engineering and combat support.
The college reports to PLA Rocket Force headquarters.

sources.title: The People’s Liberation Army’s 37 Academic Institutions (2020), pp. 203–205
sources.publisher: China Aerospace Studies Institute, US Air Force Air University
